title: Zeek：conn、DNS 與 TLS 日誌關聯
titleEn: Zeek: correlating connection, DNS and TLS logs
subcategoryTitle: 網路邊界與可觀測協定
summary: 建立合成conn.log、dns.log與ssl.log三張表；先按uid連結同一連線，再用明示時間窗處理DNS名稱關係，不只靠IP猜測。

scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: Zeek提供連線與多種應用協定日誌，可依共同識別及時間關聯觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Zeek provides connection and application-protocol logs that can be correlated using identifiers and time.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立合成conn.log、dns.log與ssl.log三張表；先按uid連結同一連線，再用明示時間窗處理DNS名稱關係，不只靠IP猜測。
knowledge.textEn: Create synthetic conn.log, dns.log and ssl.log tables; first join connection records by uid, then relate DNS names within an explicit time window rather than guessing from IP alone.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 可關聯率=具有必要共同鍵且可唯一連結的事件/總事件；共享IP與快取DNS會使名稱推論不唯一。
knowledge.textEn: Joinability is events with required keys and a unique join divided by all events; shared IPs and cached DNS can make name inference ambiguous.
